text: ポケモンに　いちばん　すかれている　ひとと　いえば　やっぱり　ナナミさんかしら！

structure.jp: ポケモンに　いちばん　すかれている　ひとと　いえば
structure.en: speaking of the person most liked by Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: ポケモンに　いちばん　すかれている
patterns.explanation: すかれる turns 'like' around into 'be liked', and に shows who does the liking; ている says it is the ongoing state. ポケモンに　いちばん　すかれている = 'is liked the most by Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜といえば
patterns.explanation: といえば after a word brings it up as the topic and says what comes to mind. すかれている　ひとと　いえば = 'speaking of the person who is liked'.

patterns.name: 〜かしら
patterns.explanation: かしら at the end is a soft, feminine way to say 'I wonder'. ナナミさんかしら = 'I suppose it's Daisy'.
